```{r, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  collapse = TRUE,
  comment = "#>"
)
```

```{r setup}
#library(spatialbiodiv)
library(tidyverse)
library(vegan)
library(scam)
library(mobr)
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = "..")
```

# Read and prepare the data

```{r}
setwd("..")
simdat1 <- read.table("data_raw/dispersal_4_rep_1_output_sample.csv", header = TRUE,
                      sep = ",")
#simdat1 <- simdat1 %>% select(-X)
```

Filter high and low fragmentation scenarios

```{r}
frag_low <- simdat1 %>%
  filter(sim_id == 10 & step == 41)

frag_high <- simdat1 %>%
  filter(sim_id == 18 & step == 41)
```

## Prepare data for spatial biodiversity curves

Get abundance tables with rows in samples and species in columns

```{r}
frag01_spec <- frag_low %>%
  select(sp_1:sp_1000)

frag05_spec <- frag_high %>%
  select(sp_1:sp_1000)
```

Get spatial coordinates of the samples

```{r}
xy_frag01 <-  frag_low %>%
  select(loc_x, loc_y)

xy_frag05 <-  frag_high %>%
  select(loc_x, loc_y)
```

# Plot coordinates of the samples

```{r}
xy_coords <- bind_rows(xy_frag01, xy_frag05)
xy_coords$fragmentation <-  rep(c("Low", "High"), each = nrow(xy_frag01))
```


```{r}
ggplot(xy_coords, aes(loc_x, loc_y)) +
  geom_point() +
  facet_grid(~fragmentation) +
  coord_fixed()
```

# Calculate non-spatial sample-based rarefaction curves (SBR)

```{r}
SBR_frag01 <- rarefaction(frag01_spec, method = "SBR")
SBR_frag05 <- rarefaction(frag05_spec, method = "SBR")
```

```{r}
SBR_data <- data.frame(nsamples = rep(1:nrow(frag01_spec), 2),
                       S       = c(SBR_frag01, SBR_frag05),
                       fragmentation = rep(c("Low", "High"),
                                           each = nrow(xy_frag01)))
```

## Plot SBR curves

```{r}
ggplot(SBR_data, aes(nsamples, S, color = fragmentation)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line() +
  ggtitle("Non-spatial rarefaction curves")
```


# Calculate spatial sample-based rarefaction curves (sSBR)

## With kNN-Algorithm
```{r}
sSBR_frag01 <- rarefaction(frag01_spec,
                           method = "spexSBR",
                           coords = xy_frag01,
                           latlong = F,
                           spat_algo = "kNN")

sSBR_frag05 <- rarefaction(frag05_spec,
                           method = "spexSBR",
                           coords = xy_frag05,
                           latlong = F,
                           spat_algo = "kNN")

```


### Create dataframe for plotting with ggplot

```{r}
sSBR_data = data.frame(distance = as.numeric(c(names(sSBR_frag01),            
                                               names(sSBR_frag05))),
                       S        = c(sSBR_frag01,sSBR_frag05),
                       fragmentation = rep(c("Low", "High"),
                                           each = length(sSBR_frag01))
                       )
```

### Plot the sSBR curves

```{r}
ggplot(sSBR_data, aes(distance, S, color = fragmentation)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line() +
  ggtitle("Spatial rarefaction curve with nearest-neighbor distance")
```

## With convexhull-Algorithm

```{r}
sSBR_frag01 <- rarefaction(frag01_spec,
                           method = "spexSBR",
                           coords = xy_frag01,
                           latlong = F,
                           spat_algo = "convexhull")

sSBR_frag05 <- rarefaction(frag05_spec,
                           method = "spexSBR",
                           coords = xy_frag05,
                           latlong = F,
                           spat_algo = "convexhull")

```


### Create dataframe for plotting with ggplot

```{r}
sSBR_data2 = data.frame(area = as.numeric(c(names(sSBR_frag01),
                                            names(sSBR_frag05))),
                       S        = c(sSBR_frag01,sSBR_frag05),
                       fragmentation = rep(c("Low", "High"),
                                           each =length(sSBR_frag01))
                       )
```

### Plot the sSBR curves

```{r}
ggplot(sSBR_data2, aes(area, S, color = fragmentation)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line() +
  ggtitle("Spatial rarefaction curve with convex-hull area")
```

# Get the difference for the spexSBR curves

## Get the distance / area values from the curve with the smaller extent

```{r}
spat_eff <- sSBR_data2 %>%
  filter(fragmentation == "Low") %>%
  select(area)
spat_eff <- as.numeric(spat_eff[[1]])
```


## Use distance function

```{r}
delta_spexSBR1 <- get_spexSBR_dist(comm1 = frag01_spec, coords1 = xy_frag01,
                                   comm2 = frag05_spec, coords2 = xy_frag05,
                                   spat_effort = spat_eff)
```

```{r}
ggplot(delta_spexSBR1, aes(spatial_effort, delta)) +
  geom_point() + geom_line()
```
# Null-model with lower and upper bound

```{r}
delta1 <- get_spexSBR_interval(comm1 = frag01_spec, coords1 = xy_frag01,
                               comm2 = frag05_spec, coords2 = xy_frag05,
                               spat_effort = spat_eff,
                               nperm = 30)
```


```{r}
ggplot(delta1, aes(spatial_effort, obs)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper), fill = "grey") +
  geom_line(aes(y = obs),linewidth = 2, color = "red") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0)
```
